summary: gen-architecture now publishes one interface per in-cluster Service (poolers included, key svcif.<ns>.<svc>, stats.url <svc>.<ns>.svc) and links every interface, exposed hosts too, to its non-init instances by an Association. A host the render cannot place resolves through those links in the published set, filtered the same way as the render's own providers, so each cross-app edge equals the one-render edge. The gate is green, and the code is committed on phase/025-P1 (ArgoCDTools 7806d46).
